name: Detoxo recipes
note: Values the Detoxo Design System keeps in components/bundle.css rather than tokens.json, copied verbatim (CSS units kept: px, %, deg). Same {name, value, usage} shape as tokens.json, so tool/design/gen_design_tokens.dart reads both with one parser. tokens.json stays a byte copy of the spec; every local decision lives here.

strength.note: Per-theme strengths of the live accent (bundle.css :root / [data-theme="dark"]).

tokens.name: k-option
tokens.usage: Mode card: the accent mixed into option-base (--option-bg).

tokens.name: k-chip
tokens.usage: Mode card's selected chip: the accent mixed into option-base (--chip-bg).

tokens.name: k-pill
tokens.usage: Unblock pill tint: the accent at this alpha.

tokens.name: k-pill-glow
tokens.usage: Unblock pill glow: the accent at this alpha.

tokens.name: k-tab
tokens.usage: Tab lens tint: the accent at this alpha.

tokens.name: k-tab-glow
tokens.usage: Tab lens glow: the accent at this alpha.

tokens.name: k-bloom-on
tokens.usage: Corner glow in an On blocker tile (opacity).

tokens.name: k-bloom-off
tokens.usage: Corner glow in a Paused or not set up blocker tile (opacity).

tokens.name: k-tile-glow
tokens.usage: Shadow tint under an On tile: the tile colour at this alpha.

tokens.name: k-arc-glow
tokens.usage: Blurred copy under the ring arc (opacity).

tokens.name: k-amb
tokens.usage: Ambient light behind the ring (opacity).

tokens.name: k-halo
tokens.usage: Ring knob halo (--halo): Light mixes the accent main, Dark its light stop, at this alpha.

tokens.name: pill-hi
tokens.usage: Unblock pill sheen, top of its vertical gradient.

tokens.name: pill-lo
tokens.usage: Unblock pill sheen, bottom of its gradient.

tokens.name: lens-hi
tokens.usage: Tab lens sheen, top of its vertical gradient.

tokens.name: lens-lo
tokens.usage: Tab lens sheen, bottom of its gradient.

tokens.name: track-from
tokens.usage: Slide track, start of its gradient.

tokens.name: track-to
tokens.usage: Slide track, end of its gradient.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Slide knob fill.

tokens.name: well-from
tokens.usage: Confirm sheet icon well, centre of its radial gradient.

tokens.name: well-to
tokens.usage: Confirm sheet icon well, edge of its radial gradient.

tokens.name: grabber
tokens.usage: Sheet grabber bar.

tokens.name: button-from
tokens.usage: Soft button, start of its 145° gradient.

tokens.name: button-to
tokens.usage: Soft button, end of its 145° gradient.

shadow.note: Per-theme component shadows (bundle.css :root / [data-theme="dark"]). Whole recipes; never mix layers.

tokens.name: pill-edge
tokens.usage: Unblock pill edge highlights.

tokens.name: lens-edge
tokens.usage: Tab lens edge highlights.

tokens.name: track-shadow
tokens.usage: Slide track, pressed in.

surface.note: Backdrop of the frosted surfaces (bundle.css .dx-glass, .dx-panel, .dx-sheet: blur(N) saturate(M)).

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Glass controls: backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Glass controls: backdrop saturation.

tokens.name: panel-blur
tokens.usage: Frosted panel: backdrop blur.

tokens.name: panel-saturate
tokens.usage: Frosted panel: backdrop saturation.

tokens.name: sheet-blur
tokens.usage: Confirm sheet: backdrop blur.

tokens.name: sheet-saturate
tokens.usage: Confirm sheet: backdrop saturation.

fixed.note: Theme-independent constants of the bundle.css recipes.

tokens.name: accent-text-ink
tokens.usage: Light coloured text mixes the accent toward this ink (--accent-text: color-mix(in srgb, accent 60%, #0b1020)).

tokens.name: accent-text-mix
tokens.usage: How far Light coloured text mixes toward accent-text-ink (the ink's share of --accent-text).

tokens.name: arc-mid-mix
tokens.usage: Light ring arc middle stop: the accent mixed this far toward its deep stop (--arc-50).

tokens.name: disc-wash
tokens.usage: Ring centre disc wash: the accent at this alpha (.dx-disc::before).

tokens.name: icon-base-hue
tokens.usage: Hue of the blue 3D mode icons; hue-rotate(accent hue - 214deg) turns them to the accent.

tokens.name: icon-saturate-on
tokens.usage: Selected mode icon: saturate(1.15).

tokens.name: icon-saturate-off
tokens.usage: Idle mode icon: saturate(.7).

tokens.name: icon-opacity-off
tokens.usage: Idle mode icon opacity.

typeVariant.note: Named styles derived from a spec style; text-transform stays at the call site.

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and section headers: caption, uppercase, 1.6px tracking (.dx-eyebrow).

override.note: Local fixes applied on top of tokens.json; report each one back to the design-system owner.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Light #7d8699 (3.03:1 on card-to) in place of the spec's #8a93a6, which is 2.55:1 on card-to, below the spec's own 3:1 rule for icons.
